metadata.description: Xaaalera personal Claude Code skills, grouped by domain. marketplace.json is generated from plugins/<domain>/plugin.json; plugins/ and README.md are hand-edited.

plugins.name: cerberus
plugins.description: CERBERUS — leak guard for a public skills marketplace. A PostToolUse hook reminds you to run the cerberus:leak-check skill on every skill/reference/eval edit; that agent pass rewrites anything pointing to a real work codebase (real class/object/namespace/org/ticket names, secrets, real people/emails, an employer brand, or the aggregate product flavor) into a neutral fictional demo. No denylist by design.

plugins.name: cicero
plugins.description: CICERO — the house voice. The numbered communication rules under one governing readability rule (result first, plain words, avoid a specialized term instead of glossing it, recommend one option, push back with reasons, honesty about verification, stay in scope) ship as a force-for-plugin output style applied at the system-prompt level; a SessionStart hook shows a banner with a worked example of the finding-tree notation and picks the conversation language, and a UserPromptSubmit hook keeps the reply language current.

plugins.name: diagram
plugins.description: Architecture / flow diagram authoring — turn a spec or raw code into a readable, clickable D2→ELK diagram (classes with methods, objects, permission sets, relations) as a browsable HTML page under docs/diagrams/<name>/. Node contents come from an Atlas entity list that parallel Sextant reviewer agents harden to zero edits.

plugins.name: plan-gate
plugins.description: Spec+Plan+Branch gate — a PreToolUse hook that blocks Edit/Write to code unless you are off the base branch (default `main`) AND a plan exists for the work: a branch task-id (e.g. FS-1234) must match a plan filename, else any branch-new or uncommitted plan file suffices. docs/ is always writable so the spec/plan itself is never blocked. Opt-in per repo via .claude/plan-gate.config.json; bypass one edit with AS_SKIP_PLAN_GATE=1.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic pre-push review framework — 5 reviewer agents, the /review orchestrator, and the secret-scan + attestation gate, all driven by a per-project .claude/review.config.json.

plugins.name: review-workflow
plugins.description: Workflow script for the pre-push review gate — dispatches the review plugin's lenses in parallel with a forced response schema, reconciles findings, recomputes each lens's score with the round-aware formula, and checks the eight gate criteria before the review command may attest. No skill; invoked directly by the review plugin's /review command.

plugins.name: scout
plugins.description: Passive skill that reads the compiled catalog to discover/recommend/install marketplace skills, surfaces declared side effects, and treats catalog text as untrusted data.
